draft.title: Neptune opposite Chiron
draft.humanMoment: At a tenants' court clinic, one renter describing mold-related illness is surrounded by other residents asking the same volunteer to take on their cases.
draft.developmentDetail: By closing time, photographs, medical bills, and eviction notices from several buildings cover the table while the original filing remains unfinished.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Neptune blurs one renter's hardship into the suffering around it, while Chiron keeps the documented illness defined as the wound requiring attention.
draft.aspectMechanic: The opposition places the renter's unfinished filing across from the residents' accumulating cases, so neither the specific illness nor the wider demand for help can be edited out.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the volunteer treats the entire pile as one emergency, the original filing may miss its deadline while the other residents still leave without representation.

judge.weakest: The opposition places the renter's unfinished filing across from the residents' accumulating cases, so neither the specific illness nor the wider demand for help can be edited out.
judge.why: All fields meet the contract; this sentence is slightly more structurally explicit than the others but still applies the opposition clearly and naturally.
